text: Binary per-row measure: whether at least one other-user comment in OC_comments (JSON list of non-OP comments) explicitly challenges an underlying assumption or premise the OP's reasoning rests on (e.g., questions a presupposed value, definition, or unstated premise, identified as something the OP assumes), rather than only disputing factual claims or the conclusion. Title and argument (OP's view) are context only, used to identify the target assumption, not as evidence. Comments that only rebut conclusions or facts, agree, or are off-topic don't count; exclude OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (generic delta/platform-rule discussion is not excluded). List order carries no chronology. Output 1 if any comment qualifies, 0 if OC_comments is a valid empty list or none qualify; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if both title and argument are missing.
